summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing its Board of Directors' approval of the company's 11th issuance of simple, unsecured, non-convertible debentures in the aggregate principal amount of R$500 million. The debentures qualify for tax incentives under Brazilian Law No. 12,431/2011 and will be offered via a public offering under automatic registration, directed exclusively to professional investors. The yield will be determined via bookbuilding, linked to NTN-B 2035 + 0.20% p.a. or IPCA + 7.80% p.a., with a 10-year term maturing July 15, 2036. Interest is semiannual; amortization begins in year 8. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
